method: git clone https://github.com/wildcat-finance/v2-protocol.git, then read both commits with git show, git ls-tree and git rev-parse; no build, compiler or RPC call was made

events: every Solidity event declaration under src/ at each commit, comments removed, parameter types resolved to ABI types (user-defined value types to their underlying type, contracts and interfaces to address), topic0 = keccak256 of the canonical signature
emitters: every emit_* function in src/libraries/MarketEvents.sol and src/spherex/SphereXProtectedEvents.sol, with its log opcode and hard-coded topic0, compared with the same-named declaration
emit sites: emit_ library calls and native emit statements for the debt events listed in debt_events, under src/market/, the two factories and the identity registry
actor roles: read from the cited source lines; every cited line was checked to contain the quoted text before this file was written

registry.row_blocker: The existing row matches core factory and stored init code but lacks the complete instance, hook and role-provider inventory. WildcatFeeRecipient and CollateralFactory source identity remains unestablished.

row_emitter_source.boundary: The earlier study records source identity and equivalence to v2.1.0; #1590 still binds the relevant deployed epochs.

registry.consumer_boundary_1485: The registry supplies only the deployed comparison base. Unreleased source selection is outside this approved scope.
